name: atlas
description: Atlas CLI + MCP + skills: build and enrich prospect lists from agents or the terminal.

args: if [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" ]; then exec "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/bin/atlas" mcp; fi; exec ./bin/atlas mcp

interface.longDescription: Import, research, enrich, filter, and export prospect lists through Atlas with safe previews and resumable workflows.
defaultPrompt: Import this Google Sheet into Atlas and show me the result.
Discover up to 100 companies similar to these domains, show me the plan, and keep the result in Atlas.
Preflight a phone waterfall, show the effective provider order, and test five rows before running the remainder.
